ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite for the Sillion plough: a three-furrow mounted mouldboard plough that a farm tractor carries on its three-point linkage, for a hard-scrabble frontier colony. Draw the PLOUGH ONLY, with no tractor. Image 1 is our approved tractor that carries it: match its outline weight, shading, harvest-green and muted yellow palette and steel grey linkage drawing only. Do NOT draw a tractor.

Square canvas, plain pure white background. North facing: the end that hitches to the tractor points to the TOP of the canvas. The plough is centred and fills about three quarters of the canvas width and height.

Its plan, top to bottom: at the top centre, the headstock: a steel A-frame with two lower hitch pins and a top link point; from it, a strong straight beam running diagonally down and to the right; along the beam, three curved polished-steel mouldboards set one behind another in a diagonal line, each with a pointed share; a small depth wheel at the rear left. A plain flat frame, sturdy and simple.

Palette as materials: harvest-green frame and beam, polished bright steel mouldboards and shares, steel grey headstock and pins, a dark rubber depth wheel, one small muted yellow accent on the beam.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No tractor, no soil, no furrows, no crop, no people, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers or logos. No floor, ground, field, shadow outside the plough, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
